cards.name: Day Camp
cards.description: The department offers a weekday summer day camp for children who have completed kindergarten.
cards.review_notes: Camp details are undated evergreen text on the page containing 2026 announcements; 2026 is a fallback, not an explicitly printed camp year. The page says the child must have completed kindergarten and cannot turn 12 before January 1 of the camp year; this cutoff does not establish a maximum age during camp. It says camp ends in August without an exact date. Registration is described only as beginning the first Monday in February and continuing until June 1 or all slots are filled; no year-specific milestone was extracted. Confirm drop-off location: the page lists the office at 30 Rec Park Drive and department contact address at 240 West Deep Creek Rd, Bryson City, NC, but neither is explicitly identified as camp drop-off, and the indoor building is currently closed. Check the unreadable flyer at https://www.swaincountync.gov/download/rec-park-camp-flyer/ for dates, activities, fees and venue.
